title: Keto Argentinian Yautia Gratin
description: A low-carb, creamy gratin dish featuring yautia, Argentinian flair, and a velvety texture.
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add sliced yautia and cook for 5 minutes, or until slightly tender.
In a separate bowl, combine velvety cheese and quick parmesan.
Transfer the yautia mixture to a baking dish and top with the cheese mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is heated through.
